description: How to make a cheese at home, step by step (przepis krok po kroku): the full recipe by name or id, e.g. "mozzarella", "gouda", "ser topiony": milk, starter culture, rennet (podpuszczka), dosage, steps with temperatures and times, salting (solenie), ripening (dojrzewanie), tips and warnings, and the brewing diary of the author when there is one. Plus the cultures from the recipe matched to the database (shop, price with date, price per litre, link) and other cultures that suit this cheese.
